newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Blast damages Russia deputy finance minister's car.
newsitem.headline: Blast damages Russia deputy finance minister's car.

text.p: A minor explosion damaged the car of a senior finance ministry official parked several hundred metres (yards) from the Kremlin on Monday but no one was hurt, police officials said.

A spokesman for the Moscow criminal police said First Deputy Finance Minister Andrei Vavilov's SAAB-9000 was standing empty near the ministry building when the blast damaged its windscreen and a door.
Police had no immediate clues as to what had caused the explosion in a tightly-guarded area where many government and top judicial offices are situated, the spokesman said.
